operators.name: TKS_OT_AcceptPresetDrift
operators.bl_description: Push the preset assignment to the active View Layer's cascade tier

operators.name: TKS_OT_AcceptPresetProperty
operators.bl_description:
Save this value into the preset.
Alt+Click: save and sync to all scenes using this preset

operators.bl_description:
Activate a Take, applying its cascade overrides.
Deactivates the previously active take in the same list

operators.bl_description: Add a new item (Ctrl+N) — creates what fits the current tree selection

operators.name: TKS_OT_AddSlot
operators.bl_description: Add a new slot to the action

operators.name: TKS_OT_AddToWatchlist
operators.bl_description:
Pin selected objects on the current View Layer.
Pinned objects are excluded from cascade action/slot assignment and auto-rename - the user manages them manually

operators.name: TKS_OT_AddViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Add a View Layer — pick the target scene and name

operators.name: TKS_OT_ApplyCustomTokenPreset
operators.bl_description: Replace your custom tokens with this preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_ApplyOutputRuleByIndex
operators.bl_description: Apply presets from this automation Rule

operators.bl_description: Apply the granular storage defaults to all open scenes

operators.bl_description: Apply a render preset to current scene

operators.bl_description: Apply the active scene.camera to a cascade override level

operators.name: TKS_OT_ApplySceneWorldToCascade
operators.bl_description: Apply the active scene.world to a cascade override level

operators.name: TKS_OT_ApplySinglePreviewRename
operators.bl_description: Apply a single pending preview thumbnail rename

operators.name: TKS_OT_ArchiveRenderVersions
operators.bl_description: Move every render version except the current and locked ones into an archive folder beside them. Files are moved, never deleted; a confirm dialog lists exactly what moves where

operators.name: TKS_OT_AssignExistingAction
operators.bl_description: Pick an existing Action to assign

operators.name: TKS_OT_AssignTagPopover
operators.bl_description: Assign a tag to this item (Scene, View Layer, Group, or Variant)

operators.bl_description: Consent to the managed 'Only Insert Available' behavior: the addon turns the preference off while Autokey is on and restores it after

operators.name: TKS_OT_AutokeyGuardDecline
operators.bl_description:
Refuse the managed behavior: Takes never touches the preference.
Re-enable the automation later under Preferences > Workflow

operators.name: TKS_OT_BatchRender
operators.bl_description: Render remaining enabled View Layers (Alt+Click to force render all)

operators.name: TKS_OT_BatchRenderBG
operators.bl_description: Render remaining enabled View Layers in background. Alt+Click to force render all

operators.name: TKS_OT_BatchRenderBGFast
operators.bl_description: Render remaining enabled View Layers in fast background mode. Alt+Click to force render all

operators.name: TKS_OT_BatchSetTag
operators.bl_description: Apply tag to all selected View Layers

operators.name: TKS_OT_BookmarkProperty
operators.bl_description: Bookmark this property for quick access in the Channels view

operators.name: TKS_OT_BrowseDirectory
operators.bl_description: Open file browser to select output directory

operators.name: TKS_OT_BrowseLocalPresets
operators.bl_description:
Browse for local presets folder.
Shift+Click to open the configured folder in your file explorer

operators.name: TKS_OT_BrowseSharedPresets
operators.bl_description:
Browse for shared presets folder.
Shift+Click to open the configured folder in your file explorer

operators.name: TKS_OT_BrowseSoundFolder
operators.bl_description:
Browse for custom sound directory.
Shift+Click to open the configured folder in your file explorer

operators.name: TKS_OT_BulkMergeIntoCascade
operators.bl_description: Merge all mismatching actions in the Watchlist into the Cascade Action

operators.name: TKS_OT_CalibrateRenderTimes
operators.bl_description: Spawn a headless Blender that probe-renders each queued view layer at a tiny resolution and extrapolates to the real settings. Foreground stays responsive; ETAs update per-row as results land

operators.name: TKS_OT_CameraNeededNew
operators.bl_description: Create a new camera (named via the naming templates, linked into the scene and aligned to the current view) and assign it to the tier set in the addon preferences (Adopt To). The cascade applies it immediately

operators.name: TKS_OT_CameraNeededPick
operators.bl_description: Pick an existing camera for the tier set in the addon preferences (Adopt To). The cascade applies it immediately

operators.name: TKS_OT_PreloadViewLayersCancel
operators.bl_description: Stop the view-layer preload. Layers already prepared stay prepared

operators.name: TKS_OT_CascadeOverflowPopover
operators.bl_description: Show collapsed cascade icons in a popover with an inline editor for the active icon

operators.name: TKS_OT_CasicRename
operators.bl_description: Rename the assigned data-block

operators.name: TKS_OT_CategoryPopover
operators.bl_description: Grouped action assignment for all targets within a category

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmpty
operators.bl_description: Delete empty slots, then delete actions that become empty. Respects the inspector's filters; preserves bound slots, fake-user-protected actions, and cascade-bound actions

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmptyActions
operators.bl_description: Delete actions visible in the current list that contain no slots. Fake-user-protected actions and actions referenced by any cascade tier are preserved

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmptySlots
operators.bl_description: Delete empty slots visible in the current list (respects action and name filters). Slots currently assigned to a datablock are preserved

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanupIncompatiblePresets
operators.bl_description:
Migrate or quarantine preset files this addon can no longer read.
Outdated/foreign preset JSON is upgraded to the current format where possible; the rest is moved to a _quarantine folder. Nothing is deleted

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAction
operators.bl_description: Clear the action assignment (simple unlink)

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAddonData
operators.bl_description: Remove all Takes for Blender (tks_) properties from this file - use before uninstalling

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllBrokenAssignments
operators.bl_description: Clear every broken cascade assignment in the file

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllCustomProperties
operators.bl_description: Remove all custom properties from all data in the blend file

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllMissingPresets
operators.bl_description: Clear all stale preset references in the scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllRestKeysForVL
operators.bl_description: Clear all rest keys for objects in the current view layer — removes each visible object's slot from the Rest State action

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearBookmarks
operators.bl_description: Remove all bookmarks from this scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearBrokenAssignment
operators.bl_description: Clear all broken references to a specific datablock name within one data type

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearCustomPropertiesByPattern
operators.bl_description: Remove custom properties matching a pattern from all data in the blend file

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearInspectorFilter
operators.bl_description: Clear all manage filter settings

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearInspectorSearch
operators.bl_description: Clear the Inspector search filter and source filter

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearKeyframes
operators.bl_description: Clear keyframes on the focused field (or transforms, with no field) across the scope's objects — the current frame by default, or the entire timeline

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearMissingPreset
operators.bl_description: Clear all stale references to a specific missing preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearPrefSearch
operators.bl_description: Clear the search filter

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearPycache
operators.bl_description: Delete all __pycache__ folders (forces fresh bytecode on next restart)

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearRuleOverride
operators.bl_description: Clear a rule override back to inherited default

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearSelectedPatterns
operators.bl_description: Clear all properties with selected patterns

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearSlot
operators.bl_description: Clear the action slot assignment

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearSlotsFilter
operators.bl_description: Clear the slots filter field

operators.name: TKS_OT_ConvertToOverride
operators.bl_description: Show information about linked objects needing library overrides

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopyIconName
operators.bl_description: Copy this icon's identifier to the clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopySlotKeys
operators.bl_description: Copy all keyframes from the selected slot to clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopySyntax
operators.bl_description: Copy this token to clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopyToken
operators.bl_description: Copy naming token to clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopyViewLayerSettings
operators.bl_description: Copy View Layer collection visibility settings to clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForMaterial
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the active object's active material

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForMaterialNodes
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the active material's node tree

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForObject
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the active object

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForObjectData
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the active object's data (Mesh, Camera, Light, etc)

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForParticleSettings
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the specified particle settings

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForScene
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForShapeKeys
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the active object's shape keys

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForWorld
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the world

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateActionForWorldNodes
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for the world nodes

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Create a new preset from current render settings

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateTake
operators.bl_description:
Create a new Take for the specified view layer.
Creates a blank take snapshot. If no take list exists yet, one is created for the Scene+VL pair

operators.name: TKS_OT_CustomTokenAdd
operators.bl_description: Add a token to an existing category

operators.name: TKS_OT_CustomTokenAddCategory
operators.bl_description: Create a new category together with its first token

operators.name: TKS_OT_EditCustomToken
operators.bl_description: Edit this custom token

operators.name: TKS_OT_EditCategory
operators.bl_description: Rename this category and choose its icon

operators.name: TKS_OT_PickCategoryIcon
operators.bl_description: Browse all icons by category and pick one for this category

operators.name: TKS_OT_CustomTokenRemove
operators.bl_description: Remove this custom token (its category disappears when its last token goes)

operators.name: TKS_OT_SetCategoryIcon
operators.bl_description: Set this category's icon

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleCustomCategory
operators.bl_description: Expand or collapse this category. Shift+Click: toggle every custom category

operators.name: TKS_OT_CustomTokenToggleFavorite
operators.bl_description: Star or unstar this token (favorites can be filtered in Build Syntax)

operators.bl_description: Hide / show this token in the Build Syntax grid

operators.bl_description: Clear action or slot from a specific datablock target

operators.bl_description: Create a new action for a specific datablock target

operators.bl_description: Action assignment for a specific datablock target

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteAllInspectorKeys
operators.bl_description:
Delete all keyframes for the selected target.
Click: Selected datatype at current frame
Alt: ALL datatypes at current frame
Shift: Selected datatype across ENTIRE timeline
Shift+Alt: ALL datatypes across ENTIRE timeline

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteAnimSlot
operators.bl_description: Delete the working-action slot for the scope's objects — removes all their animation in that action. Asks for confirmation

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteContextItem
operators.bl_description: Remove the selected item (Tree View, right side)

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteCustomTokenPreset
operators.bl_description: Delete this token preset file

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteGroup
operators.bl_description:
Delete a group, moving its members to the default 'Ungrouped' group.
The default group (first in list) cannot be deleted

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteInspectorKey
operators.bl_description: Delete a keyframe at the current frame for the specified property

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeletePreferenceConfig
operators.bl_description: Delete the selected configuration file

operators.bl_description: Permanently delete this preset file

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteRestSlot
operators.bl_description: Delete the Rest State slot(s) for the scope's objects — every rest key they hold. Asks for confirmation

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteScene
operators.bl_description: Remove the selected Scene(s)

operators.bl_description:
Delete all selected items in multi-select mode.
Handles all 5 item types: Scene Groups, VL Groups, Scenes, View Layers, and Takes. Respects the type filter - only deletes items whose checkboxes are visible. Protects default 'Ungrouped' groups, keeps at least 1 scene and 1 VL per scene

operators.bl_description: Permanently delete selected slots from their actions

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteTagItem
operators.bl_description: Delete the selected tag or group (DEL / X)

operators.bl_description:
Delete a Take.
If the deleted take was active, activates the previous take.
Cannot delete the last remaining take — delete the take list instead

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteTreeItem
operators.bl_description:
Delete the selected item (DEL / X).
Works in both tree view and split view. In split view, acts on whichever list was last clicked

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Remove the selected View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_DetectRenderVersion
operators.bl_description: Scan the output folder for existing versions and continue from the highest one found

operators.name: TKS_OT_DismissInfoBoxes
operators.bl_description:
Hide a whole category of explanatory boxes from where you see it.
The ✕ on a tip hides every tip box; the ✕ on a warning hides every warning detail box. Re-enable them in Preferences → Interface → Confirmations

operators.name: TKS_OT_DismissPreviewRenames
operators.bl_description: Dismiss all pending preview thumbnail renames without renaming

operators.name: TKS_OT_DismissSinglePreviewRename
operators.bl_description: Dismiss a single pending preview thumbnail rename without renaming

operators.name: TKS_OT_DismissStoreNotice
operators.bl_description: Dismiss the 'take data restored' notice

operators.name: TKS_OT_DebugMonitorLogFiles
operators.bl_description: Select log file. Click = dropdown list, Shift+Click = open folder in Explorer

operators.name: TKS_OT_DebugMonitorRefresh
operators.bl_description: Re-read the current log file. Alt+Click to toggle auto-refresh

operators.name: TKS_OT_DebugMonitorSetFilter
operators.bl_description: Set the debug monitor level filter

operators.name: TKS_OT_DebugMonitorSettings
operators.bl_description: Configure Debug Monitor display - line limit, columns

operators.bl_description: Copy current configuration to a new file

operators.name: TKS_OT_DuplicateTake
operators.bl_description:
Duplicate a Take, copying all its cascade overrides.
The duplicate is appended at the end of the take list and named with a '.001' suffix

operators.name: TKS_OT_DuplicateTreeItem
operators.bl_description:
Duplicate the selected item (Shift+D / Alt+D).
Acts on the blue-bar selection in the tree, not the active View Layer.
Shift+D: Full Copy (scenes) / Copy (view layers)
Alt+D: Linked Copy (scenes) / Copy (view layers — no linked concept)

operators.bl_description: Replace your custom tokens with this preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_EditRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Rename or relocate this preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_EmailSupport

operators.name: TKS_OT_ExportDebugLog
operators.bl_description: Export the debug log file to a specific location

operators.name: TKS_OT_FieldAppendToken
operators.bl_description: Append this token to the end of the field

operators.name: TKS_OT_FieldClear
operators.bl_description: Clear the last token, or the whole value, of the field

operators.name: TKS_OT_FindActionSlot
operators.bl_description: Find and select the action and slot for a datablock. Alt+Click for Scene/World

operators.name: TKS_OT_FixTokenFormat
operators.bl_description: Convert wrong-format tokens (e.g. [scene]) to the required {curly} style

operators.bl_description: Set global action that cascades to all Scenes

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalAddMenu
operators.bl_description: Route Shift+A to the active list's context add menu

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalCameraNew
operators.bl_description: Create a new camera and assign it as Global Camera

operators.bl_description: Set global camera that cascades to all Scenes

operators.bl_description: Route Ctrl+G to the active list's group operator

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalInvertSelect
operators.bl_description: Route Ctrl+I to invert multi-selection (only when multiselect is active)

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalNew
operators.bl_description: Route Ctrl+N to the active list's add operator

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalNewMenu
operators.bl_description:
Add to the Takes tree, always showing the menu (Ctrl+Shift+N).
Ignores the Ctrl+N quick-create defaults from Preferences and always opens the context add menu so you can pick

operators.bl_description: Create a new compositor node tree and assign it to this group or take

Alt+G: Move selected items back to 'Ungrouped'

Create a new Scene Group from the selected scenes.
Requires multi-select with at least two scenes selected. Members leave their current group and join the new one

operators.name: TKS_OT_GroupVLs

Create a new View Layer Group from the selected view layers.
Requires multi-select with at least two View Layers selected from the same scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_IconVisibilitySettings
operators.bl_description: Configure which cascade icons are visible in Scene and View Layer rows

operators.bl_description: Import bookmarks from a JSON file

Open addon preferences.

preferences.name: auto_assign_vl_actions
preferences.label: Auto-assign ViewLayer Actions
preferences.description: Automatically rename and assign Blender's default actions to the cascade hierarchy when keyframing. When disabled, actions keep their default names

preferences.name: auto_camera_affect_collection
preferences.label: Affect Containing Collection
preferences.description: When Show Assigned Camera is on, also unhide the camera's direct host collection (Exclude from View Layer, eye icon, and monitor icon). Touches only one host — never walks up the ancestor chain. If the camera is linked into multiple collections, the first host with an already-visible ancestor chain is preferred

preferences.name: auto_camera_hide_others
preferences.label: Hide Other Cameras
preferences.description: Hide every camera in the active scene except the one assigned to the current view layer. Stamps hide_viewport, hide_render, and the per-VL eye icon on every non-active camera

preferences.name: auto_camera_show_assigned
preferences.label: Show Assigned Camera
preferences.description: Force the camera assigned to the active view layer to be visible. Clears hide_viewport, hide_render, and the per-VL eye icon on the cascade-resolved camera

preferences.name: auto_camera_visibility
preferences.label: Camera Visibility Automation
preferences.description: Master toggle for the Camera Visibility automation. When on, the addon stamps hide flags on cameras (and optionally on the assigned camera's host collection) every time the view layer changes. Mirrored in the Takes Tree Settings popover so you can switch it without opening Preferences

preferences.name: auto_create_rest_action
preferences.label: Auto-create Rest Action
preferences.description: Automatically create a Rest State action when keyframing. When disabled, you must create it manually

preferences.name: auto_duplicate_action_mode
preferences.label: On Duplicate
preferences.description: What happens to the animation of a duplicated object. Blender normally copies the action (or, with Duplicate Data > Action off, shares it), which makes the copy and the original collide on one slot

items.label: Strip Animation
items.description: The copy comes through with no action. A duplicated action is deleted when it has no other users (the recorded animation does not tag along, like a fresh object)

items.label: Independent Slot
items.description: The copy keeps the same action but gets its own slot with an independent copy of the keyframes, so editing one no longer affects the other

items.label: Off (Blender Default)
items.description: Leave Blender's native duplicate behavior untouched

preferences.name: auto_fake_user_actions
preferences.label: Auto Fake User on Actions
preferences.description: Automatically set Fake User on all actions to prevent Blender from garbage-collecting them on save/reload

preferences.name: auto_mirror_keyframes
preferences.label: Auto-mirror Keyframes to Rest
preferences.description: Automatically mirror new keyframes into the Rest Action. Disable to prevent the addon from modifying Rest State baselines

preferences.name: auto_rename_actions
preferences.label: Auto-rename Actions on Hierarchy Change
preferences.description: Automatically rename cascade-assigned actions when their parent hierarchy is renamed (Scene, VL, Groups, Takes)

preferences.name: auto_rename_previews
preferences.label: Auto-rename Thumbnails on Name Change
preferences.description: Automatically rename preview thumbnails when a Scene or View Layer is renamed. When disabled, a warning is shown instead

preferences.name: auto_rename_slots
preferences.label: Auto-rename Slots on Target Rename
preferences.description: Automatically rename action slots when the target object, material, or other datablock is renamed

preferences.name: auto_snap_on_clear
preferences.label: Auto-snap on Keyframe Clear
preferences.description: Automatically snap unkeyed properties to Rest State values when keyframes are deleted. When disabled, use the manual Snap to Rest button

preferences.name: autokey_available_borrowed
preferences.label: Autokey Guard Borrow (Internal)
preferences.description: Internal: the addon currently holds the 'Only Insert Available' borrow and will hand it back when Autokey ends

preferences.name: autokey_manage_consented
preferences.label: Autokey Guard Consent (Internal)
preferences.description: Internal: the user accepted the managed 'Only Insert Available' behavior via the one-time consent dialog

preferences.name: autokey_manage_insert_available
preferences.label: Manage 'Only Insert Available'
preferences.description: Let the Autokey button manage Blender's 'Only Insert Available' preference. Blender 5.2 enables that preference by default, which makes autokey silently skip channels that were never keyed - and every fresh take starts that way. While managed, enabling Autokey turns the preference off and disabling Autokey restores it. Asks for consent once; editing the preference by hand withdraws it

preferences.name: camera_adopt_tier
preferences.label: Adopt To
preferences.description: Which cascade tier receives a camera adopted from the Properties editor or viewport. Scene (default) matches native Blender — the camera belongs to the scene. Higher tiers make the adoption take-specific; lower tiers share it across scenes. Adoption only fires when the chosen tier outranks the tier the current camera came from, and a tier that doesn't exist here (no group, no take) falls back to Scene

items.label: Global
items.description: Adopted cameras land on the Global tier and become the default for every scene

items.label: Scene Group
items.description: Adopted cameras land on the active scene's group and are shared by all scenes in it

items.label: Scene
items.description: Adopted cameras belong to this scene — matches native Blender (default)

items.label: VL Group
items.description: Adopted cameras land on the active view layer's group

items.label: ViewLayer
items.description: Adopted cameras land on the active view layer only

items.label: Take
items.description: Adopted cameras land on the active take only

preferences.name: camera_link_warning_mode
preferences.label: Link Warning
preferences.description: When the navigation panel's Camera Links warning appears. Only in affected scene (default) keeps it quiet until you switch into a scene the camera is missing from; Always shows it whenever any scene in the file is missing a camera the tree assigns. The tree's red camera flags show the gap in both modes

items.label: Always
items.description: The Camera Links warning shows whenever any scene in the file is missing a camera the tree assigns, wherever you are standing

items.label: Only in affected scene
items.description: Stay quiet until you actually switch into a scene the camera is missing from — the gap still shows in the tree's red flags either way (default)

preferences.name: camera_unassigned_mode
preferences.label: When Unassigned
preferences.description: What happens to the scene's camera when no camera is assigned anywhere in the Takes tree. Adopt (default) records a natively picked camera on the Scene tier so it behaves like native Blender; Preserve leaves it untouched but unmanaged; Auto-clear removes it so the addon fully owns the camera

items.label: Adopt into Scene (Native)
items.description: A camera picked in the Properties editor or viewport is recorded on the Scene tier automatically, so the tree knows about it and take switches keep it — Blender behaves like Blender

items.label: Preserve
items.description: Leave a manually picked camera untouched without recording it in the tree; the drift reminder stays visible

items.label: Auto-clear (Strict)
items.description: The addon fully owns the camera: when no camera is assigned anywhere in the Takes tree, the scene's camera is cleared

preferences.name: ctrl_n_scene_default
preferences.label: Add Scene
preferences.description: What Ctrl+N creates when a Scene Group is selected in the Takes tree. 'Ask' opens the add menu; any other choice creates that scene type instantly. Ctrl+Shift+N always opens the menu

items.label: Ask (show menu)
items.description: Open the add menu so you can choose

items.label: New Scene
items.description: Create a new, empty scene in the group

items.label: Copy Settings
items.description: Create a scene copying current scene settings

items.label: Linked Copy
items.description: Link object data from current scene

items.label: Full Copy
items.description: Make a full copy of the current scene

preferences.name: ctrl_n_viewlayer_default
preferences.label: Add ViewLayer
preferences.description: What Ctrl+N creates when a Scene or VL Group is selected in the Takes tree. 'Ask' opens the add menu; any other choice creates that view-layer type instantly. Ctrl+Shift+N always opens the menu

items.label: Ask (show menu)
items.description: Open the add menu so you can choose

items.label: New View Layer
items.description: Create a new view layer with all collections enabled

items.label: Copy Settings
items.description: Create a view layer copying current settings

items.label: Blank
items.description: Create a blank view layer

preferences.name: preload_auto_open_panel
preferences.label: Open Progress Panel Automatically
preferences.description: When an automatic preload starts after a file opens, open the View-Layer Preload panel so you can watch the progress. The panel closes itself again once every layer is preloaded

preferences.name: preload_pacing
preferences.label: Pacing
preferences.description: How hard the preloader rests between layer builds. Each build briefly occupies Blender (a layer build can't be split or backgrounded), so longer rests keep the interface smoother while the full preload takes longer

items.label: Gentle
items.description: Longest rests (4x each build's time) — smoothest while you keep working; the preload takes the longest overall

items.label: Balanced
items.description: Moderate rests (3x each build's time) — a good middle ground

items.label: Fast
items.description: Shortest rests (2x each build's time) — finishes soonest; best when you step away from the machine

preferences.name: preload_viewlayers_mode
preferences.label: View-Layer Preload
preferences.description: Pre-build view-layer dependency graphs so the first switch to each take is instant instead of lagging on large trees. The work happens quietly in the background without changing the layer you're on

items.label: Off
items.description: No automatic preload and no sidebar button

items.label: Automatic
items.description: Preload the scene's view layers shortly after a file opens

items.label: Manual (button)
items.description: No automatic preload; show a "Preload View Layers" button in the Takes tree sidebar to run it on demand

preferences.name: preset_change_mode
preferences.label: Preset Changes
preferences.description: How to handle render preset value changes

items.label: Manual
items.description: Show a warning when Render, Output, or Camera settings differ from their preset. Accept, Revert, or Sync each change individually

items.label: Drop & Re-apply
items.description: Discard any manual changes and restore the preset values automatically. Settings always match the saved preset

items.label: Always Sync
items.description: Save every change to the preset and apply it to all scenes that share the same preset

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_back
preferences.label: Back To The Viewport
preferences.description: Moving the mouse into a 3D viewport takes the window back to the scene and view layer a sequencer took it from. Off by default: with both halves on, the window follows your mouse between the two editors

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_back_on
preferences.label: Back On
preferences.description: Which ways of using a 3D viewport take you back. Hover fires as soon as the mouse enters, so click only gets a turn when it is off

items.label: Hover
items.description: Moving the mouse into a 3D viewport

items.label: Click
items.description: Clicking inside a 3D viewport

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_on
preferences.label: Switch On
preferences.description: Which ways of using a sequencer take you to the timeline. They are a ladder, not four separate doors: hover fires before any press, so the ones below it only get a turn when it is switched off

items.label: Hover
items.description: Moving the mouse into a sequencer. The most eager - it acts before you press anything, which is what makes dragging the scrub bar work straight away

items.label: Click
items.description: Clicking inside a sequencer. The most deliberate

items.label: Play
items.description: Pressing play while the mouse is over a sequencer

items.label: Playhead
items.description: Clicking or dragging the playhead itself

items.label: Arrows
items.description: Stepping the frame with the arrow keys while the mouse is over a sequencer

preferences.name: sequencer_cache_off
preferences.label: Keep Frame Cache Off
preferences.description: Keep the frame cache off on a timeline the follow is driving. A stored frame keeps the take it was rendered with, so it can show an old camera, animation or material before the correct one appears

preferences.name: sequencer_follow_enabled
preferences.label: Follow the Playhead
preferences.description: While a sequencer timeline is open, apply the take state of the scene strip under the playhead - its camera, action and materials - without leaving the timeline

preferences.name: sequencer_scene_autoswitch
preferences.label: Sequencer Scene Auto-Switch
preferences.description: Clicking, scrubbing or playing a sequencer switches the window to the scene that owns the strips, and keeps it there. Your viewport will change to that scene - this is what lets takes follow the playhead, because a window can only ever show one scene

preferences.name: world_adopt_tier
preferences.label: Adopt To
preferences.description: Which cascade tier receives a World adopted from the Properties editor. Scene (default) matches native Blender — the World belongs to the scene. Higher tiers make the adoption take-specific; lower tiers share it across scenes. Adoption only fires when the chosen tier outranks the tier the current World came from, and a tier that doesn't exist here (no group, no take) falls back to Scene

items.label: Scene Group
items.description: Adopted worlds land on the active scene's group and are shared by all scenes in it

items.label: Scene
items.description: Adopted worlds belong to this scene — matches native Blender (default)

items.label: VL Group
items.description: Adopted worlds land on the active view layer's group

items.label: ViewLayer
items.description: Adopted worlds land on the active view layer only

items.label: Take
items.description: Adopted worlds land on the active take only

preferences.name: world_needed_warning
preferences.label: Warn When No World
preferences.description: Show a warning when a scene has no World at all. Off by default: a scene without a World is a perfectly normal setup, so this is a reminder, not a problem. Turn it on if every one of your scenes is meant to carry a World and you want to be told when one does not

preferences.name: world_unassigned_mode
preferences.label: When Unassigned
preferences.description: What happens to the Scene's World when no World is assigned anywhere in the Takes tree. Adopt (default) records a manually assigned World on the Scene tier so it behaves like native Blender; Preserve leaves it untouched but unmanaged; Auto-clear removes it so the addon fully owns the World

items.label: Adopt into Scene (Native)
items.description: A World assigned in the Properties editor is recorded on the Scene tier automatically, so the tree knows about it and take switches keep it — Blender behaves like Blender

items.label: Preserve

items.label: Auto-clear (Strict)
items.description: The addon fully owns the World: when no World is assigned anywhere in the Takes tree, the Scene's World is cleared

preferences.name: undo_cascade_token_refire
preferences.label: Cascade-Token Boundary Refire
preferences.description: Re-fire the unified VL-switch snap path when undo/redo crosses a forward cascade boundary (tracked via `scene['tks_cascade_token']`). Disabling this leaves the state after a cross-VL undo at stale rest-cache values

preferences.name: undo_post_ping
preferences.label: Post-Undo Cascade Rebuild (Ping)
preferences.description: Re-attach the cascade tier within ~20 ms when Ctrl+Z lands on Blender's intermediate autokey snapshot. Without it, the object appears stuck at its keyframed position with no action assigned after Ctrl+Z (drag-and-cancel workaround still available)

preferences.name: undo_recovery_windows
preferences.label: Mutation Queue Recovery Windows
preferences.description: Gate `bpy.ops.ed.undo_push('Takes Auto-Merge')` from the mutation queue during post-undo, VL-switch, and autokey settling periods. Disabling this re-introduces phantom 'Takes Auto-Merge' undo steps — every Ctrl+Z forces 5–8 extra presses to walk past the cascade chain reactions

preferences.name: undo_skip_action
preferences.label: Skip ACTION in Post-Undo Cascade
preferences.description: Pass `skip_action=True` to `apply_overrides` in the post-undo deferred cascade. Disabling this lets the cascade read the empty cascade tier at Blender's intermediate snapshot and clear the action that was just restored — the watched object loses its action on every Ctrl+Z

preferences.name: undo_skip_camera_clear
preferences.label: Skip Camera-Clear in Post-Undo Cascade
preferences.description: Pass `skip_camera_clear=True` to `apply_overrides` in the post-undo deferred cascade. Without it, undoing back to a state where no camera is assigned in the cascade tree wipes `scene.camera` — even if the user had picked it outside the tree. Independent of `camera_unassigned_mode`, which governs normal (non-undo) cascade runs

preferences.name: undo_skip_world_clear
preferences.label: Skip World-Clear in Post-Undo Cascade
preferences.description: Pass `skip_world_clear=True` to `apply_overrides` in the post-undo deferred cascade. Without it, undoing back to a state where no world is assigned in the cascade tree wipes `scene.world` — even if the user had manually assigned it outside the tree. Independent of `world_unassigned_mode`, which governs normal (non-undo) cascade runs

preferences.name: undo_smart_hijack
preferences.label: Smart Undo / Redo Hijack
preferences.description: Replace Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z with Takes-aware operators that collapse a two-snapshot autokey gesture into a single keypress. Without it, one autokey gesture takes two Ctrl+Z presses to fully revert (value step + action step). Disable if it conflicts with other addons that also intercept undo

preferences.name: undo_snap_suppression
preferences.label: Rest-State Snap Suppression
preferences.description: Block rest-state snap-back during the 1 s post-undo grace window. Disabling this lets the snap path overwrite Blender's restored unkeyed transforms during the cascade settling period

preferences.name: undo_strategies_unlocked
preferences.label: Unlock Advanced Undo Overrides
preferences.description: Unlock the four required core strategies for editing. Disabling any of them causes known bugs (phantom undo steps, cascade tier loss, snap overwriting undo). Use only for diagnosing conflicts with other addons or recovering from an undo-related crash
